name: resolve-studio-landing
description: ResolveStudio — 10-Bit Log Color Grading Architecture for Galaxy S24 Ultra

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist/public/screenshots dist/screenshots && cp index.html styles.min.css favicon* apple-touch-icon.png android-chrome* site.webmanifest og-image.png dist/ 2>/dev/null && cp index.html styles.min.css favicon* apple-touch-icon.png android-chrome* site.webmanifest og-image.png public/ 2>/dev/null && cp -r public/screenshots/* dist/public/screenshots/ && cp -r public/screenshots/* dist/screenshots/ || true
